title: On Burning the letters one by one
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：burn　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 burn 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 the tailor ① burnt the letters one by one at once, and every customer in the shop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the tailor ② burns the letters one by one in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ burn the letters one by one at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ burnt the letters one by one before — a line in the order for November 1955 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Burning the letters one by one at once, the tailor said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the needle at the far mirror, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ burn the lamp at the door in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Burn the lamp at the door at once and never mention it again.

By 1968 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the order, and a new customer from the next shop ⑧ burns the lamp at the door at once every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the mirror, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ burnt the letters one by one again when nobody else would.

⑩ To burn the letters one by one, my mother said in 1973, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the shop remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the shop forgets, somebody burns the letters one by one in the rain again and somebody must burn the letters one by one at once all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 烧毁（一般过去式 burnt the letters one by one：1961 年裁缝头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 烧毁（一般现在 burns the letters one by one：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 烧毁（不定式 to burn the letters one by one：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 烧毁（过去完成时 had burnt the letters one by one：1955 年十一月的订单簿上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 烧毁（动名词 burning the letters one by one 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 点着（burn the lamp at the door：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去点着门口的那盏灯）
G. v. 点着（burn the lamp at the door：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 烧毁（后段两处：新来的顾客照例 burns the lamp at the door，而母亲又一次 burnt the letters one by one）

burn 意为“烧毁”，订单簿里 十一月 那行字说明早在 1968 年之前就有人烧毁过，故用过去完成时 had burnt。

burn 意为“烧毁”，新来的顾客每个星期都照例点着门口的那盏灯，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 burns。

burn 意为“烧毁”，结尾那句是母亲 1973 年的话：要烧毁把那些信一封封烧掉，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和裁缝铺记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 burn 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1961 the tailor burnt the letters one by one at once, and nobody in the shop forgot it.
Even now the tailor burns the letters one by one in the rain whenever the shop asks.
Burning the letters one by one at once, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever burn the lamp at the door in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new customer from the next shop burns the lamp at the door at once every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother burnt the letters one by one again, and the shop remembered that half.
